title: Syntax and Running Code
learning_objectives: You can write valid Python statements without syntax errors
You can explain the purpose of indentation blocks in Python

prerequisites_check.question: What is the key principle behind Syntax and Running Code?
prerequisites_check.explanation: Python requires adhering to clear lexical and semantic rules.

explanation_simple: Python is a computer language designed to read like clean English. Instead of curly braces, it uses spaces called indentation to group commands together.
explanation_technical: CPython parses source code into an abstract syntax tree (AST), compiles it to bytecode (.pyc), and executes it inside the CPython stack-based virtual machine.
